Great job', '55:08 You reviewed everything well'); a few new words came up ('40:13 guess two new words today: مكسرات', '07:06 We don't know this verb احزر'). 00:18-06:08 is warm-up talk (lazy weather, brother's birthday, date and time) and 56:21-1:02:50 is a homework check.

summary.headline: Guess-the-animal game reviewing animal and food words, plus new words: nuts, pistachio, tail, guess

rules.title: Future or 'would' with بدنا: بيكون بدنا نضل بالبيت
bullets: Past is the same shape: كان بدي

examples.line: بيكون بدنا نضل بالبيت - we'd want to stay home
كان بدي، بيكون بدي - I wanted, I'll want

rules.title: Will have = بيكون عندي (not just عندي)
bullets: عندي alone means I have now
For later, put بيكون (or يكون) before it

examples.line: not now, then it needs a بكون
بيكون عندي جاجات كتير - I'll have lots of chickens

rules.title: غير takes عن: غير عن = other than / different from

examples.line: برنامج اليوم غير عن شو خططنا ليلة امبارح - today's plan is different from what we planned last night

rules.title: General plural vs one: جاج, بقر, فواكه vs فاكهة
bullets: Some animal and food words are already a general plural

examples.line: But it's general plural so what's one?
جاج is chicken in general, general plural

rules.title: A kind of X = نوع من أنواع الـ + plural
rules.pattern: نوع من أنواع الـ + plural noun
bullets: Literally 'a type of the types of'

examples.line: نوع من أنواع الطيور - a kind of bird

rules.title: Gender agrees with the main noun: حشرة -> لونها, countries are feminine
bullets: Describe an insect with feminine forms (حشرة)
All countries are feminine: إيران مشهورة
كلبة = a female dog only; dogs = كلاب

examples.line: لأنه حشرة، so we have to stick to حشرة
Iran is a feminine. All countries are - مشهورة

rules.title: Most favourite: أكتر إشي مفضل عندي (no ال)
bullets: Most favourite: أكتر with no ال before it

examples.line: السباحة أكتر إشي مفضل عندي - swimming is my most favourite thing

also: Warm-up talk: lazy rainy weather, his brother's birthday, date and time (ten minutes = عشر دقايق)
Animal review: snake, cow, mouse, bee, sheep, chick, spider, donkey, pig, rooster, horse, cockroach, bird, squirrel, monkey
Plurals checked: فيران, حيطان, خنازير, طيور, سناجب, قرود, كلاب
Small fixes: عنده not على عنده, أدير بالي على, صوت عالي, proper nouns take no ال
Dairy review: لبن, جبنة, بوظة, زبدة, لبنة, حليب
Homework check at the end: غرفة تانية, كل قديش بيزوروك, عشان or لأن
